chunks: Ali narrated from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about ambergris and diving for pearls, and he عليه السلام said: Khums is due on it.

key_terms.الْخُمُسُ: the one-fifth tax legally due on certain forms of gain
key_terms.الْعَنْبَرِ: ambergris as a valuable marine substance discussed in khums rulings
key_terms.غَوْصِ: diving, referring to extraction from the sea

ai.seo_question: Is khums obligatory on ambergris and pearls obtained by diving?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that khums is due on ambergris and on what is obtained through pearl diving. It is part of the jurisprudence of financial obligations discussed under al-fay', al-anfal, and the limits of khums.
